calls.thesis: First tracked Hogue SNOW call and one of his favourite growth stories: Snowflake helps companies organise and use proprietary data that AI agents need, with Cortex AI built directly on that data; revenue expected up 35% this year, $1.2B operating cash flow and nearly as much free cash flow, $1.7B cash and debt being paid down — no survivability worry.
calls.price_at_call: Up ~26% over 12 months, down ~20% from the peak in last week's sell-off; analyst average target $438 (~41% upside), low target $360 (~16% upside) as stated
